blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Surrey total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Bridgeview fell from 7 in June to 3 in October (−57.1%), and 4 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 0.2% of Surrey’s 1,434 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Bridgeview?
Bridgeview also had 32 houses listed and 0 sold in October, against 3 condos and townhomes listed. The Bridgeview houses page has those figures.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Bridgeview?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 3 condos and townhomes listed in Bridgeview. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Bridgeview a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in Bridgeview had a sales ratio of not published for the month. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Bridgeview from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 4 condos and townhomes sold in Bridgeview over those 5 months, out of 737 in all of Surrey.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: What did townhomes in Bridgeview sell for?
faq.a: 6 townhomes sold in Bridgeview between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $855,000.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Bridgeview?
faq.a: The median was 28 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 95.7% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
